title: Jump Game
description:
You start at index `0` of the array `nums`. Each element `nums[i]` is the **maximum** number of steps you can jump forward from index `i`.

Return `true` if you can reach the last index, otherwise `false`.

examples.explanation: Jump 1 step to index 1, then 3 steps to the last index.
Every path ends at index 3, where the jump length is 0.

hints: Track the farthest index reachable so far.
If you reach an index beyond that farthest point, you are stuck.
